description: A test script for Git push.default configuration behaviors, including setup of repositories, testing push success and failure under various push.default settings, and workflow scenarios.

methods.name: check_pushed_commit
methods.description: Checks if the last commit in a given revision matches the expected commit in a specific repository.

methods.name: test_push_success
methods.description: Tests that a git push with specified push.default value succeeds and the remote receives the expected commit.

methods.name: test_push_failure
methods.description: Tests that a git push with specified push.default value fails and no remote branch is modified.

methods.name: test_pushdefault_workflow
methods.description: Runs a series of tests for different push.default settings within specified workflows (central or triangular).
